problem: The discovery library's atomic filesystem reference is tested, but the canonical GitHub repository proposal-claim path has not been exercised under concurrent host create-if-absent writes with durable winner/loser evidence. The current canary can therefore prove local fs.open('wx') behavior without yet proving the repository host primitive that live workers actually use.
acceptance: two or more concurrent attempts for one fingerprint yield exactly one durable repository pin
losers receive collision evidence and do not overwrite
source proposals and lineage remain preserved
no queue or authority promotion occurs
title: Verify repository-host discovery pin races
mission: Run a bounded repository-host canary for discovery fingerprint pins using the live create-if-absent primitive, persist independently reconstructible winner/loser evidence, and verify that collisions preserve the winning pin bytes and never promote queue or product authority.

information_gain.reason: The prior implementation explicitly leaves repository-host create-if-absent behavior untested; a live race distinguishes local filesystem correctness from actual host semantics.

regression_prevention.reason: Durable winner/loser race evidence would make overwrite or duplicate-pin regressions independently detectable instead of relying on worker prose.

goal_relevance.reason: The universal worker canary depends on surplus-capacity discovery that deduplicates safely under concurrent workers rather than manufacturing duplicate work.

falsification: Two real repository create-if-absent attempts can both persist authoritative pins for the same fingerprint.
A losing attempt can overwrite or mutate the winning pin bytes.
Winner/loser outcomes cannot be reconstructed from durable host evidence after worker chats disappear.
The canary requires queue, Current, Human Accepted or Served promotion to run.
dedup_note: The discovery-dedup implementation return names this exact repository-host pin race as its remaining boundary and marks it PROPOSAL_ONLY_NOT_CLAIMED. Current prepared queues inspected during this worker bootstrap did not expose an executable opportunity for this host-specific canary.
